purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: District Patiala official land-record service and the Government of Punjab village-wise Cadastral Map page are confirmed. The latter requires district/tehsil/village selection but does not expose a safe feature schema in the inspected shell.
registryAssessment: The District Patiala government identifies Punjab land-record services, a Patiala PLRS office at the district complex, and links its official land-record service. The Government of Punjab cadastral-map portal exposes village-wise map selectors for district, tehsil, and village. The inspected public shell exposes no parcel geometry response schema, stable-ID allowlist, or CRS; no selector was submitted and no map/features were requested.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official District Patiala land-record service identifies the Punjab Land Records Society and lists the PLRS office at Room 314, District Office Patiala.

Government of Punjab portal labels a village-wise Cadastral Map and publicly shows district/tehsil/village selectors. The static shell does not describe feature attributes, geometry format, stable IDs, or CRS; no selector was submitted.
Government of India DILRMP page provides Patiala tehsil-level digitization/georeferencing/parcel status statistics only; it is not parcel geometry.

accessReview.reason: The District Patiala portal lists a PLRS office at the Patiala district office and links to Punjab land-records services. The official Punjab Cadastral Map page is labeled village-wise and exposes district/tehsil/village selectors plus unrelated jamabandi navigation including owner-name, khewat, khasra, mutation and registered-deed searches. The static page provides no safe feature schema/attribute allowlist or CRS, and no form or map request was submitted. The DILRMP tehsil dashboard provides status statistics only, not parcel geometries. No owner/record/registration lookup was performed.

privacy: No owner/address/tax/account/property-record query, login, or private attribute extraction was performed. No geometry retained.

runtimeAssessment.reason: City-level land-record and state cadastral-map services are confirmed, but the public map shell did not expose a geometry-only response with safe stable IDs. Any cadastral map output may be raster or include parcel records; current geometry/identity cannot be established from the inspected page. No parcel coverage at the WUP point is asserted.
